name: Mixed Green Salad with Lentils, Roasted Beets, Snap Peas & Fresh Mozzarella (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan; add broth and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup green lentils, dried
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
1 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice beets. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, maple syrup, and spices. Stir to coat, then transfer to a baking sheet pan, spreading beets out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
pure maple syrup
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp thyme, dried
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
While the beets are roasting, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
pure maple syrup
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to coat.
Place a ¾-cup of whole snap peas on a plate. Cut remaining snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
Cut or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add a ½-cup to the plate with the whole snap peas. Add remaining mozzarella to the bowl.
When the beets are cooled slightly, add a ¾-cup to the plate. Add remaining beets to the bowl.
When the lentils are cooled slightly, add a ¾-cup to the plate. Add remaining lentils to the bowl and stir to combine. Finally, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved snap peas, mozzarella, beets, and lentils between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide salad between plates and enjoy!
